purpose: Held-out campaign over scenario family C2 only.
scope_limitation: C1, C3 and C4 scenarios are NOT implemented. RQ1, RQ2, RQ5, RQ6, RQ9 and RQ10 are therefore out of scope for this campaign and must not be reported as answered.
seed_policy: Held-out seeds 201+. Development seeds 101-105 are never reused.

rq_coverage.RQ8: not included; parameter sweep is a separate manifest
rq_coverage.RQ1/RQ2/RQ5/RQ6/RQ9/RQ10: OUT OF SCOPE - scenario not implemented

n_selection.rule: smallest n in {10,20,30} with 1.96*s_d/sqrt(n) <= 0.02 on timely_pdr
n_selection.known_shortfall: AODV-FB vs AODV-STOCK needs n=32 (s_d=0.05756); at n=30 the half-width is 0.0206 against the 0.02 target, a 3% overshoot. n=30 is the preregistered grid maximum and was kept rather than enlarged.

freshness_rule: F = max(2 s, (K-1)*M*I + 1 s), K=2, M=10, derived from ratePps and applied to every method (R022).
execution_order: condition-major, nearest-completion first, algorithm-interleaved within each condition (2026-09-21). Pure round-robin across algorithms kept every cell thin: at 814 of 2220 runs, zero of the eight conditions were complete and every ablation row rested on two paired cells. Finishing conditions one at a time yields fully populated cells progressively.
